Victory March (fight song) | "Victory March" is the fight song for the University of Notre Dame.  The Rev. Michael J. Shea, a 1905 Notre Dame graduate, wrote the music, and his brother, John F. Shea, who earned degrees from Notre Dame in 1906 and 1908, wrote the original lyrics.  The lyrics were revised in the 1920s; "Victory March" first appeared under the copyright of the University of Notre Dame in 1928.
